def VTask.bitCasesOn : {motive : ℕ → Sort u} → (n : ℕ) → (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive (Nat.bit b n)) → motive n :=
  fun {motive} n bit =>
    have h₁ : ∀ (n : ℕ), (∀ (b : Bool) (m : ℕ), motive (Nat.bit b m)) → motive n := by
      intro n h₂
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h n ih =>
        match n with
        | 0 =>
          have h₃ := h₂ false 0
          simpa using h₃
        | 1 =>
          have h₃ := h₂ true 0
          simpa using h₃
        | k + 2 =>
          have h₃ := h₂ false (k + 1)
          have h₄ := h₂ true (k + 1)
          have h₅ := ih ((k + 2) / 2) (by
            have h₆ : (k + 2) / 2 < k + 2 := by
              have h₇ : (k + 2) / 2 ≤ (k + 2) / 2 := by rfl
              have h₈ : (k + 2) / 2 < k + 2 := by
                apply Nat.div_lt_self
                <;> omega
              exact h₈
            omega)
          simp [Nat.bit_eq_two_mul_add_one, Nat.div_eq_of_lt] at h₃ h₄ h₅ ⊢
          <;>
          (try omega) <;>
          (try simp_all [Nat.bit_eq_two_mul_add_one, Nat.div_eq_of_lt]) <;>
          (try omega)
    have h₂ : ∀ (b : Bool) (m : ℕ), motive (Nat.bit b m) := by
      intro b m
      exact bit b m
    exact h₁ n h₂
